summary.prose: Building this is four small changes in the TypeScript parser and the review's test-file predicate: credit calls outside any function to the file, keep calls in class fields, constructors and generator declarators, teach isTestFile the other languages' conventions, and prove end to end that a test file now reaches the code it calls.

tasks.title: TypeScript calls outside any function are credited to the file
tasks.summary: walkNode extracts calls with the file entity as caller from program-level statements that are not declarations it handles, from each non-function declarator value of a program-level or exported lexical/variable declaration, and from an export_statement's value (export default <expr>); exported function and class declarations are walked as today and never scanned with the file as caller.
acceptanceChecks: Calls in a program-level expression statement, including nested describe/test callbacks, are CALLS from the file entity, in .ts and .js sources.
Non-function program-level and exported initializers, and export default, are CALLS from the file entity.
Calls in function declarations, class methods, exported functions and classes and function-valued declarators keep their caller and are not credited to the file.
Built-ins are skipped; a module-level HTTP call is a CALLS_HTTP from the file entity.

tests.name: src/indexer/parser/__tests__/typescript-module-level-calls.test.ts: calls in a program-level expression statement (including nested describe/test callbacks), a non-function program-level or exported initializer, other program-level statements and export default, in both TypeScript (.ts) and JavaScript (.js) sources, are CALLS from the file entity; calls in function declarations, class methods, exported functions and classes and function-valued declarators keep their caller and are not credited to the file; built-ins are still skipped; a module-level HTTP call is a CALLS_HTTP from the file entity

tasks.title: Class field initializers, constructors and generator declarators keep their calls
tasks.summary: extractClass extracts calls with the class entity as caller from non-function field initializers (public_field_definition and field_definition) and from the constructor body; extractArrowFunction treats a generator_function value as a function, so a generator-valued declarator gets its own function entity and caller.
acceptanceChecks: Field-initializer and constructor-body calls are CALLS from the class entity in TS and JS sources.
A function-valued field is not credited to the class.
A generator-valued declarator gets a function entity whose calls are not credited to the file.

tests.name: src/indexer/parser/__tests__/typescript-module-level-calls.test.ts: in both TypeScript and JavaScript sources, calls in class field initializers (public_field_definition, field_definition) and the constructor body are CALLS from the class entity, a function-valued field is not credited to the class, and a generator-valued declarator gets its own function entity whose calls are not credited to the file

tasks.title: isTestFile recognises Python, Go and JVM test files
tasks.summary: isTestFile also matches test_*.py, *_test.py, *_test.go, a src/test/ directory, *Test.java/.kt/.scala and *Spec.scala, keeping both existing branches.
acceptanceChecks: Every path accepted before, including any file under __tests__/, is still accepted.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/grounding.test.ts: isTestFile accepts test_*.py, *_test.py, *_test.go, src/test/ paths, *Test.java/.kt/.scala and *Spec.scala as well as every path it accepted before, and rejects ordinary source files

tasks.title: A TypeScript test file reaches the code-review grounding end to end
tasks.summary: An integration test runs the real TypeScript parser, the real cross-file resolver over a temporary graph store and assembleCodeReviewGrounding with the real graph deps for a test file whose test callback calls an imported function, and asserts the test file's entity in that function's testsReaching.
acceptanceChecks: The called function's testsReaching lists the test file's entity, produced without any fixture-supplied caller edge.

tests.name: src/indexer/__tests__/test-callers-reach-grounding.test.ts: for a TypeScript test file whose test('...', () => { ... }) callback calls a function imported from another file, the real parser, the real cross-file resolver over a temporary graph store and assembleCodeReviewGrounding with the real graph deps list the test file's entity in the function's testsReaching
